qa.title: Q1810 (Dec. 12, 2025)
qa.question: I have 6 max play points. If I choose option 1 for Neo Universe's On Evolve ability and discard Katsuragi Ace, can I then summon Katsuragi Ace with its "When this card is discarded" ability?
qa.answer: Yes. Katsuragi Ace's ability resolves after Neo Universe's On Evolve ability finishes resolving, so you will have gained 1 max play point and entered Overflow.
